method: Read immutable Git objects and compare valid-input arithmetic, bounds, conversion state, representation, lifetime and cleanup against public declarations. Trace in-corpus scanner wrappers and preserve excluded primitive/allocator/syscall dependencies.
limitations: Source inspection only; tests and builds were excluded.
Per-path residuals preserve excluded implementations, callers, compiler arithmetic and locale/type dependencies.
Caller-invalid strings, NULL pointers, prohibited overlaps, invalid comparators, unrepresentable absolute values/quotients and zero division are outside the stated valid-input review.
Shared narrow/wide scanner agreement supplies one shared implementation assumption rather than an independent oracle.

path_dispositions.disposition: Source/object membership agrees; compiler policy, install and archive dependency behavior remain separate.
Volatile byte writes over supplied range reviewed; generated code, register copies and physical persistence remain unmeasured.
Empty/short/single-byte cases and final candidate bound reviewed for valid object ranges; primitive correctness and quadratic worst-case work remain dependencies.
Stops at source NUL or reject-byte match for valid strings; huge pointer-difference representability remains residual.
Static 64-byte sysctl output and bounded unsigned-decimal fallback reviewed; sysctl termination remains dependency; later call overwrites result.
Bounded destination scan, NUL reservation and attempted length reviewed for disjoint objects; source termination, NULL extension and length-sum overflow remain residuals.
Bounded copying/termination and complete source-length scan reviewed; source termination and prohibited overlap remain caller obligations.
NUL-bounded search excludes NUL as a match; equality reviewed for matching byte representations and valid strings.
Empty tokens, delimiter replacement and caller continuation reviewed; returned pointer borrows writable source lifetime.
Advances through non-NUL accepted bytes for valid strings; large pointer differences remain residual.
Empty needle, first-byte scan and suffix comparison reviewed conditional on strlen/strncmp; repeated prefixes can cause quadratic work.
Delimiter skipping, in-place termination and static continuation reviewed; nested/interleaved scans overwrite state.
Caller continuation and token termination reviewed for distinct save states and valid writable storage.
Volatile read of every byte and OR-reduced mismatch reviewed; generated timing and side channels remain separate evidence.
